metrics.profile_summary: Marketing specialist with 3 years of experience driving paid and organic growth for B2B SaaS and B2C e-commerce. Expert in social media management, performance marketing, and GTM strategy execution.

education.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration (Major in Media and Marketing)

experience.description: Managed social media accounts and content calendars. Scaled Meta Ads to 2.7x ROAS and led GTM strategies for B2B SaaS, utilizing GA4 and Excel for data-driven reporting.
Defined brand positioning and managed content calendars. Collaborated with design teams to create visual assets and high-converting ad copies for digital channels.
Produced SEO-optimized articles and managed technical SEO workflows, including WordPress publishing and Google Search Console monitoring.

strengths: Direct experience with all required tasks including content calendars and agency coordination
Proficient in all 'nice-to-have' tools: Meta Business Suite, Canva, and Excel
Proven track record of delivering measurable ROAS and lead generation
weaknesses: Degree is still in progress (expected May 2025)
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, possessing both the required 2+ years of experience and the specific technical toolkit requested. His background in both organic and paid social media aligns perfectly with the job description.
